items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Ray and I came up together, and the last time I saw him he didn't know who I was.

ctx.x: Shelly Manne Charlie Mann said he enjoys it up to a point, and then he finds it frustrating and maddening because he needs to stretch out and really play jazz. And if he takes all the studio calls he gets, there's not much time left to play jazz and he almost forgets how. Ray Brown has said that --
Well, Ray does an awful lot of playing other than for that show.

Now he does but (inaudible) that for awhile Ray was doing all studio work, and not any live playing. And he said that he'd forgotten how. He would hear things and think things he wanted to play but he couldn't make his fingers respond until he played for a couple weeks.
